text: Gate stack: pre-commit has 7 blocking sub-gates (comment hygiene, agent mirror-sync, mirror parity, prompt-card sync, MCP mutation-class, route re-mint, spec re-mint, tool ownership map); pre-push blocks naming + mass deletion and runs the skill-root metadata gate; prepare-commit-msg mints Commit-Id via the sk-git allocator, identifying the repo by the allocator's path. All checkers live under .opencode/scripts/git-hooks/ or .opencode/skills/** with hardcoded paths.

Mirror parity BLOCKS a rename commit (MIRROR_SOURCES matches old paths; six --check scripts then run against moved sources; only SPECKIT_SKIP_MIRROR_PARITY=1 escapes; missing scripts skip silently). Agent mirror-sync BLOCKS (filter ^\.(opencode|claude)/agents/ matches; no bypass flag exists). Route re-mint blocks when it cannot fix. Comment hygiene SILENTLY DISENGAGES if .opencode/skills/sk-code is gone. Hook-flags resolver fail-open: env kill-switches stop working post-move.

core.hooksPath = ~/.config/git/hooks; all 7 entries are symlinks into the MAIN checkout's .opencode/scripts/git-hooks/*. Moving the main checkout dangles all seven at once — the migration's own validation gate disappears when needed. install-git-hooks.sh computes HOOK_SOURCE_DIR from the moved path. Git's exact behavior with a dangling hook symlink is inference (skipped, not fatal) — a scratch probe would settle it.

19 workflow files reference .opencode (1 to 54 refs each); path filters key triggers on .opencode/** (rename commits still match via deletions; post-move .skilled/** changes trigger nothing unless filters update in the same commit). 12 of 19 carry silent-skip patterns when a guard script is missing (markdown-link-integrity prints a warning and exits 0). Named: markdown-link-integrity, runtime-no-spec-import (.opencode/bin/**), spec-kit-check (33 refs), routing-registry-drift (54 refs).

'skilled' is already a namespace in the repo's grammar: pre-push accepts skilled/vA.B.C.D release branches; allowlist contains skilled/v4.0.0.0; several workflows trigger on skilled/** or skilled/v*. Directory name .skilled/ collides verbally with the release-branch namespace — a deliberate naming decision for the design.

Ordering constraints (not a sequence): external hook reinstall before/around the commit; gates that read sources updated before they run against moved sources; CI filters in the same commit; only two bypass flags exist (SPECKIT_SKIP_MIRROR_PARITY, SPECKIT_SKIP_COMMENT_HYGIENE) plus route/spec remint flags; agent mirror-sync has none.

Four live external references name .opencode: 7 git-hook symlinks in ~/.config/git/hooks (dangle), ~/.codex/hooks.json 18 command strings (fail at exec), ~/.hermes/config.yaml mcp args (fail at first tool call), ~/.codex/config.toml [projects.".../Public/.opencode"] trust entry (orphaned). Path-keyed state that survives: ~/.codex projects "Public" + hooks.state keys, ~/.hermes trusted_project_dirs, ~/.claude.json root-keyed projects, ~/.pi/agent symlinks to .pi/*, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md symlink. Clean negatives: ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.config/devin/*, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/plugins. ~/.zshrc PATH entry for $HOME/.opencode/bin is stale (dir absent).
No in-repo validator checks that an external reference still resolves; check-git-hooks.sh covers only the git-hook symlink class when a session runs it. The F4.7 inventory is the whole safety net.

noveltyJustification: First gate-by-gate block-vs-silent-skip statement, installed-hook chain from main checkout, 12-of-19 silent-skip CI census, skilled namespace collision, complete external-reference table with failure timing — all new.

ruledOut.reason: The directory does not exist; the ~/.zshrc PATH entry is stale
